name: rookward
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a refined original brand identity concept board for a serious staff-facing application coordinating student attendance, instructor handoffs, observations and continuity across visits. Dark, confident, sophisticated, crafted figurative emblem paired with a memorable wordmark. Original illustration and lettering, no copying any existing trademark. Landscape board with generous negative space: dominant large stacked emblem and wordmark on left, smaller flat one-color master and compact app-header proof on right. The app header only needs name and Home / Student Roster / Center Activity, no invented student data. A small secondary brushed-metal proof may demonstrate signage finishing but the primary mark must work in flat ink. No stock geometric monogram, shield, automotive crest, esports badge, cartoon mascot, glowing eyes, ornamental circle, mock Latin motto, gold luxury-hotel aesthetic, generic AI swooshes, photoreal animal or extraneous explanatory text. All logo variants must be consistent with the same underlying drawing. Brand text exactly "ROOKWARD". Develop rook + ward as a single identity: an alert rook bird looking back over one shoulder, compact folded wings, sculpted substantial body, elegant strong beak, no crown or chess piece. Distinctive asymmetrical silhouette with finely controlled engraved feather cuts, high contrast positive and negative areas, deliberate hierarchy of detail. Tail and body form an enduring recognizable profile. Draw like an exceptional contemporary wood engraver adapting a historic institutional emblem for software. Use charcoal #14161B, cold platinum #D9DDE4 and a very restrained oxblood accent. Wordmark: substantial custom wedge-serif capitals, firm interesting R and W, tightly considered spacing, contemporary and legible not dainty luxury. Header uses a simplified solid version of the same bird with just a few feather cuts. Large master entirely flat platinum; separate tiny metal sample restrained satin nickel, no shiny chrome theatrics.
